subject: the whole-contract context packet, measured where it reaches the model
method: The packet is built by the real server builder over stubbed leaf reads for one authorized contract on one tenant, then formatted by the real prompt-block formatter. Every content number below is counted over the formatter's output string with the fixed answer-format footer removed, because that footer is the block's instruction to the model rather than contract content retrieved for it. Nothing is read off a builder's return value. Governance verdicts come from the repo-owned graph walk in scripts/audit/lib/route-reachability.mjs, the same walk the route-reachability audit and the route-ownership map use.
grainWarning: A route-level reachability verdict is not evidence about a packet. One of the two routes named by the item reaches the governance seam module through unrelated code while the packet it formats never touches it, so the per-module verdicts are the answer and the per-route ones are recorded only to show that the coarser question answers wrongly.
inheritedPremiseCorrected: The master backlog records this packet as carrying 'a document count only'. On the server-built path there is no document count either: the dataset, cube and top-vendor summaries all resolve to null because the builder does not write the keys that feed them.
